name: Birchwood Living
description: Living room specialist. Value shop: solid everyday pieces at sensible prices. We carry rugs, armchairs, coffee tables, sofas, floor lamps.
skill_description: We sell rugs, armchairs, coffee tables, sofas, floor lamps, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
